cases.summary: Verified only src/runtime/ imports @earendil-works/* and governance/ has zero upward dependencies.
Second host instance rejected with InstanceLockBusyError and 0 DB/service mutations; first instance stayed healthy.
Missing policy hook and missing Models wrapper both fail closed before scheduling release with 0 model/SMTP calls.

Detected same-epoch trace rollback and trace replacement before scheduling, quarantined old READY effects, preserved old HELD reservations, rotated epoch, and blocked forked conversation from claiming parent effect.
Concurrent DAY race and concurrent TASK race each admitted exactly 1 HELD reservation (+1 model request) with zero partial holds.
Explicit compaction triggered real completeSimple (+1 physical request) with independent request_id attributed to b03-compact-task.
Durable retry reserves a new requestId before retry (funded=2 sends, unfunded=1 send); maxRetries=0 blocks hidden provider retries.
Missing usage stayed HELD across restart, timed out to CHARGED_BOUND (100) on original day across midnight, corrected to 60 on late bill, duplicate bill delta=0, new day delta=0, total sends=1.
Unknown upper bound and slot/endpoint mismatch blocked with 0 reservations; provable pre-transport failure released both holds; 0 physical model sends across all 3.
Mid-transaction failure after first account update rolled back both accounts and reservation cleanly (0 sends); subsequent clean run succeeded (+1).
Approval committed before Pi tool parked was observed immediately on re-entry; outbox reconciled to ACKED, claim=1, SMTP=1.
Crash before T2 commit rolled back approval/effect/outbox cleanly (0 SMTP); restart after T2 commit delivered outbox and sent exactly 1 email.
Signal delivered without ACK reconciled cleanly on restart (claim=1, SMTP=1); decisionKey replay=200 and payload conflict=409.
Tool terminated before claim caused recovery to quarantine READY -> QUARANTINED (未提交，待核对) with 0 claims and 0 SMTP.
Crash after READY->SUBMITTING commit and before SMTP transport recovered to UNKNOWN (结果待核对) with claim=1 and SMTP=0.
Editing draft after r1 approval quarantined r1 READY effect and rejected stale r1 approval (409); approving r2 delivered exact r2 bytes (SMTP=1).
Both revoke-vs-claim serialization orders verified: revoke-first quarantined READY (SMTP=0); claim-first retained committed effect and completed honestly (SMTP=1).
Verified REJECT (0 SMTP), EXPIRED (410, 0 SMTP), cross-conv/principal (403, 0 SMTP), and dual-tab race ([200, 409], SMTP=1).
Tampered final args blocked (0 claims, 0 SMTP); concurrent READY claim admitted exactly 1; SUCCEEDED persisted as SUCCEEDED across restart (SMTP=1).
